plate_comment: Selects battery_voltage_selected: the battery voltage sensor value (sensor channel 4: the battery voltage tables, faults 66 / 67 = P0562 / P0563), or its default value when the sensor fault status is 2; sets battery_voltage_source to 2 in that case and 0 otherwise. Read by the EGR valve and VGT valve duty compensation and the motor current estimates. (was cm848_selectTurboModeParameters)
evidence: code: sensor channel 4 init (cm848_sensorChannel2_init) passes the battery_voltage_linearization tables and fault bits 0x43 / 0x42 = faults 67 / 66, which the ROM slot table 0x5985a and obd_dtc_code_table 0x5b57c decode to P0563 / P0562 (system voltage high / low). e2m: Battery_Voltage_High_Error / _Low_Error (0x01103608 masks 8 / 4).

plate_comment: Sets battery_voltage_source from the battery voltage sensor fault status: 0 for status 0 or 1, 2 for status 2; the value itself is selected by cm848_selectBatteryVoltage. (was cm848_updateTurboModeState)
evidence: code: reads the same fault status and writes the source flag only. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Second stage of the driver over-current check: raises the retry counter (governor_speed_rate_d, second word) by exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_driver_over_current_fail_increment up to the maximum count while the over-current is flagged and no retry is active, lowers it by the pass decrement when it is flagged no more, resets it when the give-up enable word is set, and derives the retry-allowed flag and the clear-conditions flag (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_driver_over_current_clear_conditions_met_flag). (was cm848_processSensorProtectionRamp)
evidence: code: reads the retry-allowed state and the give-up enable word (0x3fd7fe, e2m T_EGA_Enable_Driver_OC_Give_Up); calibration words 0x4067a2-0x4067a6 are C_EGA_Driver_OC_Fail_Incrt / Max_Count / Pass_Decrt. e2m: EGA_Driver_OC_Fault_Clear (0x01190902).

plate_comment: Over-current check of the EGR valve motor driver: while the estimated motor current is at or above exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_driver_over_current_threshold the set timer rises by the time increment up to the set time (it falls by the time decrement otherwise) and the over-current is flagged at the set time; a clear timer counts the passes without over-current, the retry counter of cm848_updateExhaustGasRecirculationValveDriverOverCurrentRetryCounter decides retry or give-up, and fault 727 (mask 0x80 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735) is set while the over-current is flagged and the clear conditions are not met, and cleared when they are. (was cm848_processSensorFaultDetection)
evidence: code: thresholds 0x4067a8-0x4067ae and 0x4067aa are C_EGA_Driver_OC_* (+0x08 to +0x0e of the block 0x01190800 that anchors 0x4067a0). e2m: EGA_Driver_Over_Current (0x0110365A mask 0x80).

plate_comment: Boot reset of the EGR valve driver over-current check: zeroes the set timer, the clear timer and the retry counter and the flags and clears fault 727 (mask 0x80) in the detected and registered fault words. (was cm848_initSensorFaultVariables)
evidence: code: clears exactly the words of the over-current check and mask 0x80. e2m: EGA_Driver_Over_Current (0x0110365A mask 0x80).

plate_comment: Estimates the EGR valve motor current into exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_current (0.000976562 A per count): the applied voltage is (|the previous pass drive duty| + exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_offset) x battery_voltage_selected >> 8 while logical output request 67 is set and fault 744 (mask 256 of fault_detected_bits_736_to_751, the variable geometry turbocharger electrical fault - not this valve's own fault 726) is clear; the back electromotive force is the change of the position sensor value x exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_speed_back_electromotive_force_factor / 2048 (limited to +-32000, sign from the previous direction request, request 68); the current is |voltage - back EMF| / the circuit resistance (reference resistance + winding temperature x temperature coefficient), limited to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_current_maximum. (was cm848_calculateSensorDiagnosticValue)
evidence: code: gates on logical output request 67 and fault 744, uses the previous pass duty (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_limited_previous) and exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_sensor_value; disassembly 0x1905c-0x19064 reads 0x3fe9d0 mask 0x100 (the VGT electrical fault word), not fault_detected_bits_720_to_735 0x40. e2m: EGA_Back_EMF / EGA_Circuit_Resistance / C_EGA_Speed_EMF_Factor etc. sit at the matching offsets of the 0x0117A900 and 0x0117BF00 blocks.

plate_comment: Per-pass current update of the EGR valve motor: runs the current estimate, then filters the square of the current (current x current >> 13) into exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_mean_squared_current; called from cm848_phase_group_b_processing. (was cm848_updateBoostFuelCorrectionSquaredAverage)
evidence: code: calls the current estimate and filters its square into exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_mean_squared_current, the same structure as cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerMeanSquaredCurrent. e2m: EGA_Mean_Squared_Current (0x0117A904).

plate_comment: Valve over-temperature timer of the EGR valve: counts up to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_over_temperature_inhibit_time while the coolant temperature is below its default, the coolant source is the sensor, and the filtered boost_fuel_correction is below exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_over_temperature_delta_pressure_threshold; when the count is reached while motor over-temperature fault 728 (mask 0x100 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735) is set it sets mask 0x800 (fault 795) of fault_detected_bits_784_to_799. A test (fault_detected_bits_720_to_735 & 0x100) != 1 is always true, so the bit is cleared again on every pass and fault 795 cannot stay set (disassembly 0x19340-0x19360). (was cm848_processSensorMonitoringLogic)
evidence: code: disassembly 0x19340-0x19360 (rlwinm mask 0x100, cmpwi 1, beq) shows the clear always runs. e2m: EGA_Valve_Fault_Over_Tmptr (0x01103664 mask 0x1000, .12 file; relative order after the VGT bit only).

plate_comment: Thermal model of the EGR valve motor: heats the winding temperature (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_winding_temperature, 1/8 degree F) from the mean-squared current x exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_normalized_resistance above the iron core temperature, derives the iron core temperature (1/64 degree F) from the winding temperature, the ambient temperature (coolant temperature, or its default when the coolant source is not the sensor, plus the housing offset) and the temperature fraction, both through first-order filters; sets the warning flag at the warning threshold and fault 728 (mask 0x100 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735) at the high threshold (cleared below the low threshold), then runs the valve over-temperature timer. (was cm848_updateEngineModeFromSensor)
evidence: code: reads the mean-squared current, the coolant temperature and the thermal calibration words at 0x4067c0-0x4067d0, sets mask 0x100 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735. e2m: EGA_Over_Temperature (0x0110365A mask 0x100) and C_EGA_Tmptr_* (0x0117BF10-0x0117BF20).

plate_comment: Boot init of the EGR valve motor thermal model and current estimate: clears fault 728 (mask 0x100) in the detected and registered fault words, zeroes the mean-squared current filter, loads the previous position sensor value, the previous direction request (request 68) and the previous drive duty, and starts the winding temperature filter at the coolant temperature / 8 and the iron core temperature filter at the coolant temperature (0 when it is below 1). (was mpc555_processSensorValidation)
evidence: code: initialises exactly the words the estimate and thermal model use (previous position / direction / duty and the three filter states). e2m: C_EGA_Tmptr_Fil_Cnst_1 / _2, C_EGA_Current_Avg_Fil_Cnst.

plate_comment: Closed-hold condition of the EGR valve loop: while the position command is 0 a counter (boost_pressure_governor_ramp_working) rises to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_hold_maximum_time (reset when the command is non-zero); exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_hold_flag is set when the command is 0 and either the counter has reached that time or the position (or the staged command) is at or below exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_hold_position_threshold. It selects control state 1. (was cm848_checkSensorRangeConditions)
evidence: code: counter limit is 0x40682c and threshold 0x406824, which are C_EGA_Max_Time_To_Zero_Hold (+0x42) and C_EGA_Zero_Position_Thd (+0x3a) of the block that anchors 0x4067ea. e2m: EGA_Zero_Hold_Status (0x0117AC06).

plate_comment: Selects exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_control_state: 4 (disabled) while logical output request 67 is clear, otherwise 3 (diagnostic drive: autozero holding duty) when exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_diagnostic_override_flag is set, 2 (user duty override) when bit 1 of exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_user_override_flags_cal is set, 1 (closed hold) when exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_hold_flag is set, else 0 (closed loop). (was cm848_calculateSensorBlendFactor)
evidence: code: five states, 4 when request 67 is clear. e2m: EGA_Control_State (0x0117AC08) is documented as 0 closed-loop, 1 OL hold, 2 user pwm OD, 3 diagnostic pwm OD, 4 disabled - the same five states.

plate_comment: Gain scheduling of the EGR valve loop: loads the working derivative gain, proportional gain, integral gain, feedforward load offset, integral lower limit and position reference filter coefficient from the zero-command (valve closing) set when the position command is 0 and from the normal set otherwise. (was cm848_processSensorBlendState)
evidence: code: the two gain sets are the _state_1 / _state_0 calibration words 0x4067ee-0x406808 and 0x40680a / 0x40680c. e2m: C_EGA_*_Normal / C_EGA_*_Zero pairs (+0x04 to +0x22 of the block that anchors 0x4067ea).

plate_comment: Staged closing of the EGR valve position command: when the command is below exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_stage_command_threshold the staged command (governor_speed_ramp_state) is moved by the ramp rate per pass (0 while the position is at or above the stage position threshold) and never below 0; at or above the threshold it is reset to the threshold. The result is the larger of the staged command and the command, exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_command_final. The loop reference (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_reference_unfiltered) is that value in control states 0 and 1 and the measured position in the other states. (was cm848_selectSensorBlendOutput)
evidence: code: thresholds 0x40681c-0x406820 are C_EGA_Stage_Cmd_Thd / _Position_Thd / _Ramp_Rate (+0x32 to +0x36). e2m: EGA_Position_Cmd_Final (0x0117AC04).

plate_comment: Position command stage of the EGR valve loop: the command is the calibrated override value when bit 0 of exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_user_override_flags_cal is set, 0 when exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_diagnostic_override_flag is set, otherwise throttle_fuel_demand_limit (the EGR valve command of the EGR / assist controller, 12800 = 100 percent, 0 in the dump); while boost_decel_mode_flag is set (engine speed 0, bit 0 of switch_input_state_bits[0] clear, coolant above boost_decel_input_threshold_cal) it is 12800, or 0 when boost_correction_alt_mode_cal is non-zero; it is capped at throttle_fuel_rate_cal (12800) and stored in exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_command. Then runs the closed-hold check, the control state selection, the staged command and the gain set selection. (was cm848_initSensorBlendVariables)
evidence: code: the setpoint is throttle_fuel_demand_limit, +0x06 (EAC_EGR_Valve_Cmd) of the block 0x40a3a2 that cm848_calculateLoadIntegral fills; its assist throttle sibling (+0x00, throttle_fuel_rate_reference) has no reader in the binary, this word has exactly one. e2m: EAC_EGR_Valve_Cmd (0x01169F06), EGA_Position_Cmd (0x0117AC20), C_EGA_Cmd_Override_Value (0x0117AB02).

plate_comment: Anti-windup of the EGR valve loop: sets exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_integral_enable_flag (governor_speed_range_active_flag) to 0 while the battery compensated duty is at its upper working limit with a positive error or at its lower working limit with a negative error (the error then pushes further into the limit), otherwise to 1. (was cm848_processSensorBlendCalculation)
evidence: code: the flag gates the integral input of cm848_calculateExhaustGasRecirculationValvePidDuty. e2m: EGA_Error_I_Term_Input (0x0117AC10) description: I term error after deadband and anti-windup.

plate_comment: PID stage of the EGR valve position loop: filters the reference (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_reference_filtered), forms the position error against exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position, and sums the proportional term, the derivative term (filtered error change x gain >> 3, off below the noise band), the feedforward load offset, the friction avoidance term while the motor current is at or above the steady-state limit, and the integral term (accumulator >> 14, only outside the steady-state error band and not wound up) into exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_pid_duty (limited to +-32767; 12800 = 100 percent). (was cm848_sensorMonitoringMainLoop)
evidence: code: read in full; the integral accumulates only after a pass in control state 0 (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_control_state_previous = 0). e2m: EGA_P_Gain / EGA_D_Gain / EGA_I_Gain / EGA_FF_Term / EGA_Governor_PWM (0x0117AC0A-0x0117AC20).

plate_comment: Picks the drive duty from the control state: state 0 takes exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_pid_duty, state 1 the closed hold duty, state 2 the user override duty, state 3 the autozero holding duty and state 4 gives 0; states 1 to 4 are bounded by the override lower and upper duty limits. The result is exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_selected. (was cm848_selectFuelDemandUpperLimit)
evidence: code: exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_control_state selects the source: 0 PID, 1 exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_closed_hold_drive_duty, 2 exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_override_value, 3 exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_diagnostic_override_value, 4 zero, then the clamp. e2m: EGA_PWM_Selected (0x0117AC2A).

plate_comment: Compensates the selected drive duty and the upper duty limit for the supply voltage (x battery_voltage_nominal / battery_voltage_selected, 224 / 192 in the dump), limits the duty to the lower and upper limit and to +-32767 and stores it in exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_clamped; the compensated duty limit is capped at +-12800. (was cm848_calculateFuelDemandLimits)
evidence: code: shares battery_voltage_nominal / battery_voltage_selected with the VGT stage cm848_limitVariableGeometryTurbochargerBatteryCompensatedDuty (224 / 192 in the dump). e2m: EGA_PWM_Battery_Compensated / EGA_PWM_Clamped (0x0117AC28 / 0x0117AC2C), C_EGA_Compensated_PWM_Lim.

plate_comment: Output stage of the EGR valve loop: the sign of exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_duty_clamped sets (duty at or above 0) or clears logical output 68, the direction request, driving its line immediately - inverted when exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_direction_reversal is 1 - and |duty| x 2 (25600 minus it when the polarity reversal is set) is the PWM duty (25600 = 100 percent), forced to 0 for one pass after a direction change or below the zero threshold; the duty goes to the output channel record of entry 39 (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_pwm_output_channel_cal), which is 0 (unassigned) in this calibration. (was cm848_applyFuelDemandProtection)
evidence: code: logical output 68 is driven through cm848_setLogicalOutputAndDriveLine(0x44); its line (protection_event_output_line_cal[68]) is 0 in the dump. e2m: EGA_Motor_Cmd_Opening_Direction (0x01157708 mask 0x10) and EGA_PWM_Abs (duty / period / map).

plate_comment: Stage 3 of the EGR valve position loop: cm848_selectExhaustGasRecirculationValveDutyByControlState, cm848_limitExhaustGasRecirculationValveBatteryCompensatedDuty and cm848_outputExhaustGasRecirculationValveDirectionAndDuty in that order; called by cm848_runExhaustGasRecirculationValvePositionControlLoop. (was cm848_processFuelDemandLimits)
evidence: code: calls the three stages in order, as cm848_driveVariableGeometryTurbochargerMotor does for the VGT. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Per-pass runner of the EGR valve position loop: cm848_updateExhaustGasRecirculationValvePositionCommandAndControlState, cm848_calculateExhaustGasRecirculationValvePidDuty and cm848_driveExhaustGasRecirculationValveMotor in that order; called by cm848_runExhaustGasRecirculationValveFaultAndPositionControl. (was cm848_processSensorAndFuelDemand)
evidence: code: runs the position command stage, the PID stage and the motor stage. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Boot init of the EGR valve position loop: clears the previous error and duty state, sets the previous control state to 3, points the reference filter and the derivative filter at their coefficients and, when exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_pwm_output_channel_cal is 1 to 50, enables that output channel record, sets its duty to 0 and its period to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_pwm_period. (was cm848_initFuelDemandLimitVariables)
evidence: code: calls the enable / set-duty / set-period slots of output_channel_driver_table for the entry 39 record only when 0 < record < 51; the record word is 0 in this calibration. e2m: EGA_PWM_Abs_Map / EGA_PWM_Abs_PWM_Period_Cal.

plate_comment: Retry timer of the EGR valve H-bridge fault path: while the fault input (the argument) is present the count rises by exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_fault_retry_increment up to the retry time, otherwise it falls by 1 to 0; a latch is set at the limit and cleared at 0, and exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_fault_retry_trigger_flag is set when the input is absent and the latch is 0. (was cm848_processConditionTimerA)
evidence: code: same scheme as cm848_updateVariableGeometryTurbochargerHBridgeFaultRetryTimer; limit 0x406834 and step 0x40684a are C_EGA_HB1_Retry_Time (+0x00) and C_EGA_HB1_Retry_Increment (+0x16). e2m: EGA_Fault_HB1_Retry (0x0117C202).

plate_comment: Fault counter of the EGR valve H-bridge fault path: keeps a short history of the retry-active flag, raises the counter by exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_fault_fail_increment up to the maximum count while the fault input is present, lowers it by the pass decrement when the input is absent and the retry has been active, sets exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_fault_set_flag at the set threshold and the clear flag at 0, and recomputes the retry-active flag. (was cm848_processConditionTimerB)
evidence: code: counter limit 0x406836, decrement 0x406838, increment 0x406840, set threshold 0x406844 are C_EGA_Fault_HB1_Max_Count / Pass_Decrt / Fail_Incrt / HB1_Fault_Set. e2m: EGA_HB1_Fault_Clear / EGA_Fault_HB1_Fault_Set (0x0117C200 / 0x0117C20C).

plate_comment: Retry timer of the EGR valve H-bridge inrush fault path, same scheme as the fault retry timer, on the inrush input (bit 0x100 of supervisor_register_162_status): the count rises by exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_inrush_retry_increment up to the inrush retry time, and exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_h_bridge_inrush_retry_trigger_flag is set when the input is absent and the latch is 0. (was cm848_processConditionTimerC)
evidence: code: limit 0x40683a and step 0x406846 are C_EGA_HB1_Inrush_Retry_Time / _Retry_Incrt. e2m: EGA_Fault_HB1_Inrush_Retry (0x0117C204).

plate_comment: Fault counter of the EGR valve H-bridge inrush fault path (same scheme as the fault counter): raises the counter by the inrush fail increment up to its maximum count while the inrush input is present, lowers it otherwise, and sets fault 724 (mask 0x10 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735) at the inrush fault set threshold (cleared when the flag at 0 is reached). (was cm848_processConditionTimerD)
evidence: code: limit 0x40683c, decrement 0x40683e, increment 0x406842, set threshold 0x406848 are C_EGA_HB1_OC_Max_Count / Pass_Decrt / Fail_Incrt / HB1_OC_Fault_Set; sets mask 0x10. e2m: EGA_Fault_HB1_Inrush (0x0110365A mask 0x10), EGA_HB1_Inrush_Fault_Clear.

plate_comment: EGR valve driver (H-bridge) fault handler: reads and clears bits 0x10 / 0x40 / 0x100 of supervisor_register_162_status (the third and fourth inputs, masks 4 / 8, both take bit 0x100, or both take bit 0 of switch_input_state_bits[2] when bit 0 of fuel_feature_control_flags is set; the inrush input keeps bit 0x100), runs the retry timers and counters and sets or clears faults 720 to 723 (masks 1 / 2 / 4 / 8), the inrush fault 724 (mask 0x10) and the electrical fault 726 (mask 0x40) of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735, and writes exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_driver_fault_pending_flag. (was cm848_processFuelDemandFaultConditions)
evidence: code: masks 1 / 2 / 4 / 8 / 0x10 / 0x40 of fault_detected_bits_720_to_735 are the e2m masks of EGA_Fault_HB1A / HB1B / HB1_OC_HI / HB1_OC_LO / HB1_Inrush / EGA_Electrical_Fault (0x0110365A). All have no DTC slot in the 0x5985a table.

plate_comment: Boot-time reset of the EGR valve H-bridge fault path: clears masks 1 to 0x40 (except the control error bit 0x20) of the detected and registered fault words 720 to 735, the retry timers, the fault counters, the latches and the history flags. (was cm848_initFuelDemandFaultVariables)
evidence: code: clears the words of both fault paths and masks 0x01-0x1f and 0x40. e2m: EGA_Fault_HB1* masks at 0x0110365A.

plate_comment: Autozero conditions of the EGR valve: a hysteresis counter counts up to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_autozero_retry_time while the enable-timeout timer and fault 718 (mask 0x4000 of fault_detected_bits_704_to_719, position autozero error) are clear; exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_ready_for_autozero_flag is set when |exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_sensor_value| is below the autozero tolerance or the counter has reached its limit (cleared while the enable-timeout timer is set); the hold counter (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_autozero_hold_counter) is reset by the timer or fault 718 and otherwise counts up to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_autozero_active_time while ready; exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_diagnostic_override_flag (diagnostic drive, control state 3) is set while the hold counter is below that time, and the holding duty is copied to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_drive_diagnostic_override_value. (was cm848_processFaultTimingConditions)
evidence: code: calibration limits 0x40684c / 0x406850 are C_EGA_Autozero_Active_Time / _Retry_Time and 0x40684e the holding duty C_EGA_Autozero_PWM_Value (+0x00 to +0x04 of the block 0x0117C000). e2m: EGA_Ready_For_Autozero (0x0117AA0C).

plate_comment: Enable and diagnostic conditions of the EGR valve loop: exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_motor_ok_flag is set when no driver fault is pending and faults 726 / 727 / 728 are clear; the enable-timeout timer follows the electrical fault, the position sensor status (2 or more) and the control error 725; the position diagnostic override (exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position_diagnostic_override_flag, command forced to 0) is set while over-current or over-temperature is present or the diagnostic drive runs; logical output request 67 (the PWM enable) is set unless the driver fault is pending or the position sensor / control error problem has lasted fewer than 200 passes, and the autozero enable flag follows it. (was cm848_updateFaultConditionState)
evidence: code: sets / clears logical output requests 67 (0x43) with cm848_setLogicalOutputRequest(0x43, 0); line of request 67 is 0 in the dump. e2m: EGA_Motor_OK / EGA_Pos_Diagnostic_Override / EGA_PWM_Enable (0x0117AA04 / 06, 0x01157708 mask 8).

plate_comment: Boot init of the EGR valve autozero conditions: clears the ready-for-autozero flag, the hysteresis counter and the hold counter. (was cm848_initFaultTimingVariables)
evidence: code: clears the three words of the autozero conditions only. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Per-pass runner of the EGR valve module: cm848_updateExhaustGasRecirculationValveEnableAndDiagnosticConditions, then cm848_runExhaustGasRecirculationValvePositionControlLoop. (was cm848_processFaultAndFuelDemand)
evidence: code: the two calls in order; the enable and diagnostic conditions come first. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Selects coolant_temperature_selected (1/64 degree F): the generic sensor channel 2 value (coolant temperature tables, faults 16 / 17 = P0118 / P0117) or its default when bit 1 of its fault status is set; sets coolant_temperature_source to 2 in that case and 0 otherwise. (was cm848_mainLoop_step_3)
evidence: code: the generic channel (cm848_sensorChannelGeneric_update_configBundle) passes coolant_temperature_linearization_axis / _values and fault bits 0x10 / 0x11 = faults 16 / 17, decoded to P0118 / P0117 (coolant temperature circuit high / low). e2m: Coolant_Temperature_High_Error / _Low_Error (0x01103602 masks 1 / 2).

plate_comment: Boot init of the coolant temperature source: sets coolant_temperature_source from the fault status (0 or 1 sensor, 2 default) and loads coolant_temperature_selected from the sensor value. (was cm848_initialization_step_11)
evidence: code: the init counterpart of cm848_selectCoolantTemperature. e2m: none.

plate_comment: Sets exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_autozero_active_flag when the valve is in closed hold or the autozero holding drive is running, the autozero enable flag is set and the autozero logic enable word is non-zero; copies it to exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_autozero_enabled_monitor (0x40a670). (was governor_speedModeB_activeFlag_update)
evidence: code: the written word 0x40a670 is EGR_Valve_Autozero_Enabled (+0x0c of the position block that anchors 0x40a664). e2m: EGR_Valve_Autozero_Enabled (0x01179D0C).

It is compiled in and runs every pass but is NOT fitted / driven on this truck. 46 function rows, 197 global rows and 16 new_global rows are proposed (the three shared words fuel_timing_error_scale, boost_fuel_scale_cal and fuel_demand_boost_input are settled as battery voltage and coolant temperature: the two wave 6 uncertain rows are answered). CODE (proven): (1) setpoint = throttle_fuel_demand_limit (0x40a3a8), the EGR valve command output of the EGR / assist controller cm848_calculateLoadIntegral (a PI controller on throttle_rate_error = fuel_demand_rate_limiter - egr_fraction_actual; fuel_demand_rate_limiter is the rate-limited egr_fraction_combustion_command, cm848_calculateTurboBlendOutput); the block 0x40a3a2 lines up with the e2m EAC block 0x01169F00 word by word (+0x06 EAC_EGR_Valve_Cmd = 0x40a3a8, +0x0c feedforward = throttle_rate_coeff_snapshot, +0x0e integral term, +0x10 proportional term, +0x12 / +0x1a the P / I gains, +0x14 preset, +0x16 preset lift) and its assist throttle sibling (+0x00 EAC_Asst_Throt_Cmd = throttle_fuel_rate_reference 0x40a3a2) is computed but has no reader anywhere in the binary, while 0x40a3a8 has exactly one reader, the twin. (2) feedback = sensor channel 75 (0.5-4.5 V, ADC 102 -> -6, ADC 921 -> 15988, fault bits 642 / 643) through a learned zero offset (cm848_updateExhaustGasRecirculationValvePositionAutozero, fault 718) into exhaust_gas_recirculation_valve_position, 12800 = 100 percent; the position source word (0 sensor / 2 default) and the closed flag (boost_fuel_mode_active) are consumed outside the module: the EGR fraction limiter passes its command only while the valve is not closed (or boost_fuel_correction is below boost_fuel_correction_threshold), and cm848_limitMassChargeFlowReference uses the density limit while it is closed. (3) outputs = the sign of the compensated duty as logical output 68 (direction), |duty| x 2 as PWM on the output channel record of entry 39 (EEPROM 0x860, actuator_output_channel_g_cal), enabled by logical output 67; motor current, mean-squared current, winding / iron core thermal model and over-current / H-bridge fault paths as in the VGT sibling. E2M (corroboration only; e2m is the .12 file): the EGA / EGR blocks 0x0117AB00 (cal, +0x00 is C_Battery_Voltage_Nominal = 0x4067ea), 0x0117AC00 (state = 0x40a6c2), 0x0117A900 (thermal = 0x40a69e), 0x0117AE00 / 0x0117BF00 / 0x0117CD00 / 0x01190800 / 0x0117C000 (calibration) and 0x01179C00 / 0x01179D00 (position autozero / position, 0x40674e / 0x40a664) agree with the code at equal relative offsets for every row below; EGA_Control_State is documented as the same five states; e2m names and descriptions say 'EGR valve motor', 'EGR H-bridge', 'EGR valve position'; T_EGA_Cycle_Counter (EGR valve closings over its lifetime) matches DAT_003fdfb4, which cm848_countExhaustGasRecirculationValveClosings increments on each closed hold edge. DTC: none. The ROM slot table 0x5985a maps faults 642, 643, 718, 720-728 and 795 to slot 170 (no code), and the whole obd_dtc_code_table (0x5b57c, 170 entries) holds no EGR code (no P0400-P0409, P0488, P2412 / P2413); fault 729 = P0299 shares the word 720-735 (e2m Boost_In_Range_Low_Error, not EGR). Output channel entry 39 = 0, protection_event_output_line_cal[67] and [68] = 0 (no line), sensor channel 75 reads -2001 = ADC 0 (floor; its ROM config 0x59446 has thresholds 1023 / 0, which a 10-bit reading cannot cross, the same config as channel 101), throttle_fuel_demand_limit = 0, fuel_demand_rate_limiter = 0 (and, per the caller, the EGR tables are zero), fault 718 (position autozero error) is set in the dump so the position is the default 9216, and the EGR delta pressure (channel 105, fault 691) and orifice temperature (channel 108, fault 797) low faults are set too - all three EGR sensor inputs read below their limits and none of these faults has a DTC.The module still runs: logical output request 67 is set (dump 0x40c088 = 0x18) and the control state is 3 (autozero drive, duty 0) because the hold counter cannot complete while fault 718 is set. FAULT BITS (decoded through ROM 0x5985a -> obd_dtc_code_table 0x5b57c; fault n = word n / 16 bit n % 16; e2m word = 0x01103600 + 2 x word): sensor channel 75 high / low = 642 / 643 (e2m EGR_Position_Before_Autozero_High / Low_Error); position autozero error 718 (mask 0x4000 of fault_detected_bits_704_to_719, e2m EGR_Valve_Autozero_Error); word 720-735 = diagnostic_status_bits (0x3fe9ce, registered copy sensor_fault_status_flags 0x3fea32): 720 / 721 / 722 / 723 H-bridge status bits (masks 1 / 2 / 4 / 8, e2m EGA_Fault_HB1A / HB1B / HB1_OC_HI / HB1_OC_LO), 724 inrush (0x10), 725 position control error (0x20), 726 electrical fault (0x40), 727 driver over-current (0x80), 728 motor over-temperature (0x100) - the e2m masks 1 to 0x100 of 0x0110365A; 729 = P0299 (e2m Boost_In_Range_Low_Error, same word, not this module); 795 valve over-temperature (mask 0x800 of fault_detected_bits_784_to_799; e2m EGA_Valve_Fault_Over_Tmptr is 0x1000 in the .12 file, only the order after the VGT bit agrees); 796 / 797 EGR orifice temperature high / low (channel 108), 690 / 691 EGR delta pressure high / low (channel 105).
